prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Companion in Action", "Preview animations, sound effects, and behavioral traits live before adoption.", "Live Motion Preview", "Sound Effect Preview"]
1: ["Sign In to Safeguard & Sync Your Desktop Pet", "Your companion data and traits automatically bind to your account, preventing data loss across app updates.", "Existing pets are restored immediately upon login.", "Cloud Restore Protection Active", "Cloud Storage Sync Status"]
2: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Try Desktop Controls Now", "Practice hiding your pet to the system tray and bringing it back to your screen.", "Got It, Finish Setup", "Action Controls Test", "Shortcut: Press Alt+P to instantly show or hide your companion."]
3: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Pet", "Pick a ready-made companion for instant setup or craft a custom pet from photos."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Setting up graphics rendering and screen bounds for your companion.", "Desktop Window Layer Verification", "Display Bounds Verified"]
5: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Position your pet centered in bright lighting for optimal 3D desktop companion generation.", "Choose Front Pose Photo"]
6: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on your desktop to access quick settings or minimize to tray.", "Tray Control: Right-Click Pet Icon", "Double click pet to open companion chat window."]
7: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Connecting your account saves your pet's personality, level, and items safely to the cloud.", "Signing in never deletes your current pet. Existing companion progress is automatically merged."]
8: ["Find Your Ideal Companion Match", "What Do You Use Your Desktop For Most?", "Answer 2 quick questions to get your recommended companion setup path.", "See Recommended Path", "Primary Activity"]
9: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "You can minimize this window. We'll play a chime and notify you when your pet is ready!", "Ready Chime Alert Enabled"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information about the user's desktop activities and habits.
